instruction: Create a new directory called 'project-backup' in /home/user.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a directory named 'project-backup' in /home/user. Evaluator checks if directory listing contains the directory name.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies directory creation using ls -la output parsing
Metric properly filters for directories only by checking line.startswith('d')
Metric uses exact match comparison (dir_name == dirname), avoiding false positives from substring matching
Logic correctly excludes '.' and '..' directories from matching
Previous issues with substring matching and directory type verification have been fixed
